description: Validate an interface and, if it is clean, save it as a draft: it appears in OSCAR under File > Open project or template, with a Draft badge. It is a file for a person to review: nothing is published, nothing is sent, and no project is changed. An existing draft of the same name is only replaced when overwrite is true.

name.description: The draft's name, shown in File > Open project or template (up to 80 characters; longer is cut)

overwrite.description: Replace an existing draft of the same name

name: create_draft
title: Save a draft for the person to review
